capabilities: Record meeting audio from the microphone
Transcribe audio and video locally with Whisper
Separate and name speakers by voice
Generate summaries, action items, tickets and questions with an LLM
Import WhatsApp and Telegram chat exports
disambiguation: Not a quick-capture or note-creation tool; it records and transcribes meetings and chats and generates AI notes from them.
extras: Recording, transcription and speaker separation need the desktop app; on mobile only chat import, summarization and the sidebar work. The one-step setup script is macOS-only, and Linux/Windows support is untested. Voice fingerprints are stored in ~/.take-note/ outside the vault.
motivation: Nobody wants to take notes in meetings.
problem: Taking notes by hand during meetings is tedious, and raw recordings or transcripts are not turned into structured, actionable notes inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Action items as - [ ] tasks with owner, priority and 📅 due date (works with the Tasks plugin)
record it with Obsidian's built-in Audio recorder on the phone
transcription (whisper.cpp) and speaker separation (sherpa-onnx) all run locally

requires.name: OpenAI, Claude or OpenRouter API key

summary: Records meetings, transcribes them locally with Whisper, labels speakers, and has an LLM write structured notes with tasks and tickets.
